reply:
Hi Kevin,

Thank you for your inquiry about our Portable Blender Cup (model BL-35P). An Amazon US launch needs the right compliance documents, so I'll start with certification and material status.

1. FCC
This model does not have an FCC SDoC test report at the moment. Our current documents are CE (EMC) and the UN38.3 battery test report. If FCC is required for your listing, one option is to order samples and have them tested at a lab you nominate. If you would like us to look into testing on our side, please let me know and I will come back to you with the details. Testing time and cost would need to be agreed before the order is confirmed.

2. BPA free
The cup body is made of Tritan. Our material supplier has issued a BPA-free declaration for the raw material. Please note this is a supplier declaration only. The finished product has not been tested by a third-party lab, so we cannot provide a BPA-free test report for the finished cup. If you need one for Amazon, the samples can also be tested by your lab.

3. Price
For 2,000 pcs, our price is USD 6.20/pc FOB Ningbo. For 5,000 pcs and above, it is USD 5.70/pc. I understand your target is USD 5.20, but we are not able to reach that level, even at higher volumes.

If the goods are shipped by container (LCL/FCL), we can also quote FCA Ningbo, which may better reflect the actual handover point. Please let me know how you plan to ship.

4. Lead time
Our lead time is 35 days after deposit and artwork confirmation, so we cannot ship within 25 days. If your launch date is fixed, we suggest placing the order as early as possible.

5. Logo and packaging
We can print your logo on the color box free of charge, since the order is over 1,000 pcs. Please send your logo as a vector file (AI/PDF/EPS). Packing is 40 pcs per carton.

Other details:
- Capacity: 350 ml
- Battery: 2,000 mAh, USB-C charging
- Blades: 6 stainless steel blades
- Operation: one button, with auto power-off when the cup is detached
- Battery life: about 12 blends per charge (our factory test)
- Payment: 30% T/T deposit and 70% against B/L copy, or L/C at sight
- MOQ: 1,000 pcs

Next steps:
- Samples: charged at the unit price. International freight is paid by the buyer, and the sample cost can be deducted from your bulk order.
- Video factory audit: we can arrange one through an Alibaba video call if you'd like to see our production line.

Could you let me know whether you would like to arrange FCC testing, how you plan to ship the goods, and whether the 35-day lead time works for your schedule? I'm happy to prepare a formal PI once these points are clear.

Best regards,
Sales Team
Yongjiang Small Appliances
internal_brief_zh: 客户：Brightline Home LLC（亚马逊美国站），BL-35P 便携榨汁杯 2000 个，彩盒印 logo。已报 FOB 宁波 6.20（5000+ 为 5.70），交期 35 天，客户目标价 5.20、要求 25 天出货，均未答应。需内部确认：1）FCC SDoC 我方是否能安排测试，费用和周期各是多少；2）Tritan 材料商的 BPA-free 声明能否原件提供给客户，声明只针对原材料，对外不得说成品已检测；3）2000 个约 50 箱，大概率走 LCL 拼箱。回复里已说明可另报 FCA 宁波，需确认实际运输方式和 FCA 价格；4）生产排期能否保证 35 天。
notes_zh: 本版只按两条风险提示修改：BPA 部分明确写成“材料供应商对原材料的声明，成品未经第三方检测”；在 FOB 宁波报价后补充集装箱运输可另报 FCA 宁波，并请客户说明运输方式。其余内容与上一版保持一致。
